name: @nodelibraries/ioc
description: Type-safe IoC container for TypeScript and Node.js, inspired by .NET's ServiceCollection: singleton, scoped and transient lifetimes, keyed services, lifecycle hooks and circular-dependency support. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')"
scripts.test:dist: npm run build && node test/dist/smoke.mjs && node test/dist/smoke.cjs && for f in examples/js/*.cjs; do case $f in *express*) ;; *) node $f > /dev/null || exit 1;; esac; done && echo 'dist ok'
scripts.check:package: npm run build && npx -y publint --strict && npx -y @arethetypeswrong/cli --pack .
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:dist
